- Added League play: join a League event to get a starter deck, then queue for best-of-three Duels against other League players using only cards from your own collection
- League decks are built in the game from your collection, with a 3-card sideboard you can swap in between games (at most 2 mythics and 6 rares per deck)
- League collection view: card art in color, rarity and name order with a copy count on each card
- League leaderboard with current and previous event standings
- No Rematch button on League games
- Lobby: Tournaments and Puzzles buttons moved to their own line
- Added puzzle Fear Itself
- New and updated steampunk, futuristic and neon card skins for a number of cards
